product_one_liner.value: D·engage is a composable customer-experience data and omnichannel engagement platform that helps marketers unify customer data, segment audiences, personalize communications, and orchestrate campaigns across channels.
product_one_liner.notes: The company describes its product as a Customer Experience Data Platform with native omnichannel engagement and says it empowers marketers.

pricing_page.notes: A public pricing page describes its Mix and Play pricing approach.

named_customers.notes: The About page presents these brands among the customers it says trust D·engage.

employee_band.notes: The company reports 170+ employees, which falls in the requested band.

hq_location.notes: The company profile identifies London, United Kingdom as headquarters.

founded_year.notes: The company announcement says D·engage was founded in 2018.

eng_blog.notes: The index is a marketer-oriented blog; a technical/AI article identifies its authors as Product, CX & Marketing teams rather than engineers, and the index does not establish two engineer-authored build posts.

public_docs.notes: The public documentation index lists multiple Zeki AI user-guide articles as well as Developer Guides.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current official listings show business-development roles and technology roles titled Full Stack Developer and Software Engineering Intern, with no AI, ML, or data-science role title.

model_provider.notes: Reviewed the public Zeki documentation, product page, trust FAQ, blog, and subprocessor listings; none identifies the AI model or model provider.

compliance_certs.notes: These are the requested compliance items named on D·engage's trust page; ISO 27701 and KVKK are omitted because they are outside the requested list.

last_funding.notes: Dealroom lists a $2.0 million Series A in September 2025; the company's September 3, 2025 announcement confirms the investment, but does not disclose an amount.

raised_18mo.notes: D·engage announced an investment on September 3, 2025, within the 18 months before November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current official board lists three Business Development Representative openings, including a Lebanon posting opened August 31, 2026.

launched_6mo.notes: A dated public release tracker reports D·engage launched Composable AI Marketing Orchestration on September 22, 2026, within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Hesham El Nashar's profile records a VP CX role at D·engage beginning December 2025 and ending January 2026, within the 12-month window.
